name: MonarchSavingsPanel
title: SavingsPanel
wrapsNative: MonarchSectionCard with Text, MonarchFlowLayout of MonarchStatusBadge chips, a VStack of item rows (MonarchMoney, MonarchStatusBadge, Date.FormatStyle), Button with a plain style for chips and rows
summary: What unused items cost to keep: a headline with the count and renewal cost per currency, the reasons they count as unused, the decisions made so far, what letting them lapse would save, and the top items.
whenToUse: On a billing or asset overview, to show what renewing unused things (domains, licences, seats) would cost and what has been decided about them, with a way into each group and item.
whenNotToUse: For a list of upcoming renewals with owners and next steps use MonarchRenewalsPanel. For a single KPI use MonarchStatCard.
api: init(unusedCount: Int, costs: [MonarchSavingsAmount] = [], unpricedCount: Int = 0, categories: [MonarchSavingsCategory] = [], decisions: [MonarchSavingsDecisionCount] = [], potentialSavings: [MonarchSavingsAmount] = [], items: [MonarchSavingsItem] = [], maxItems: Int = 6, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, locale: Locale? = nil, calendar: Calendar? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, labels: MonarchSavingsPanelLabels = MonarchSavingsPanelLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onCategorySelect: (@MainActor (MonarchSavingsCategory) -> Void)? = nil, onItemSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchSavingsItem) -> Void)? = nil, @ViewBuilder actions: () -> Actions)

init(unusedCount: Int, costs: [MonarchSavingsAmount] = [], unpricedCount: Int = 0, categories: [MonarchSavingsCategory] = [], decisions: [MonarchSavingsDecisionCount] = [], potentialSavings: [MonarchSavingsAmount] = [], items: [MonarchSavingsItem] = [], maxItems: Int = 6, registry: MonarchStatusRegistry? = nil, title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, locale: Locale? = nil, calendar: Calendar? = nil, isLoading: Bool = false, errorMessage: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, labels: MonarchSavingsPanelLabels = MonarchSavingsPanelLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onCategorySelect: (@MainActor (MonarchSavingsCategory) -> Void)? = nil, onItemSelect: (@MainActor (MonarchSavingsItem) -> Void)? = nil) where Actions == EmptyView
struct MonarchSavingsAmount { init(_ amount: Decimal, currencyCode: String) }
struct MonarchSavingsCategory { init(id: String, count: Int, label: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchSavingsDecisionCount { init(id: String, label: String, count: Int) }
struct MonarchSavingsItem { init(id: String, name: String, category: String? = nil, date: Date? = nil, amount: MonarchSavingsAmount? = nil, isUnpriced: Bool = false, decision: String? = nil) }
struct MonarchSavingsPanelLabels { init(title:, headline:, categories:, decisions:, potentialSavings:, items:, more:, unpriced:, emptyTitle:, emptyMessage:, errorTitle:, loading:) }

options.name: unusedCount
options.description: How many items are unused. Zero shows the empty state.

options.name: costs
options.description: The renewal cost of the unused items, one amount per currency, joined with + in the headline. Never converted or added across currencies.

options.name: unpricedCount
options.description: Unused items without a price; counted in the headline, never estimated.

options.name: categories
options.description: The unused items grouped by reason, shown as badges with counts. Groups with no items are hidden.

options.name: decisions
options.description: How many items have each decision, on one line.

options.name: potentialSavings
options.description: What letting the marked items lapse would save, one amount per currency.

options.name: items
options.description: The unused items to list, most urgent first.

options.name: maxItems
options.description: Lists at most this many items, then "and <n> more".

options.name: registry
options.description: Statuses for the category and decision badges, looked up before those installed with monarchStatusRegistry(_:).

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces the built-in title Savings.

options.name: description
options.description: A line under the title.

options.name: locale
options.description: The locale of amounts and dates. Default: the environment's.

options.name: calendar
options.description: The calendar and time zone of dates. Default: the environment's calendar in the environment's time zone.

options.name: isLoading
options.description: Shows skeleton rows.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: Shows the error state with this message.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows Try again busy.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Shows Try again in the error state.

options.name: onCategorySelect
options.description: Opens the items of a category. Makes each category a button.

options.name: onItemSelect
options.description: Opens an item. Makes each item a button with a chevron.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons or a menu at the trailing edge of the header, such as Review all.

states.name: summary
states.description: The headline, categories, decisions, potential savings and items, each shown only when given.

states.name: shortened
states.description: More items than maxItems: the first ones and "and <n> more".

states.name: loading
states.description: The section card's skeleton rows, read as Loading savings.

states.name: empty
states.description: unusedCount of zero: a small MonarchEmptyState, Nothing unused.

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with the message and Try again when onRetry is given.

appearance: A MonarchSectionCard. The headline is in the subheading style, categories are small MonarchStatusBadges with a count, decisions a muted label line, potential savings strong body text in the strong success colour, and items have the name in the strong body style with outlined category badges, a muted date, the amount and a decision badge. All colours are theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The web's category and item links (href with renderLink) become onCategorySelect and onItemSelect, which the app uses to push a filtered list or the item's screen. The web's emptyIcon is the empty state's own symbol here, and its minorUnits flag is not offered (pass major units as Decimal, as MonarchMoney does). The web's headingLevel has no iOS equivalent. The parity map names List rows; the rows are a VStack inside the card because the panel sits in the app's own scrolling screen. Android builds the same component, with an emptyIcon slot. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onCategorySelect, onItemSelect). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The title has the header trait (from MonarchSectionCard).
Each category is one element read as its label and count; with onCategorySelect it is a button with a 44-point touch target.
The decision line is read with the prefix Decisions.
Each item is one element whose label is its name and whose value is its category, date, amount and decision, built by a tested pure function; with onItemSelect it is a button.
Badges have words and icons, so categories and decisions never depend on colour.
edgeCases: Costs in several currencies are joined with +, never converted or summed.
An item with isUnpriced shows No price; an item with neither an amount nor isUnpriced shows no amount.
Categories with a count of zero are hidden.
A negative maxItems lists no items and counts them all as more.

examples.title: Unused items
examples.template:
MonarchSavingsPanel(
    unusedCount: {{unusedCount}},
    costs: [
        MonarchSavingsAmount({{costs.0.amount}}, currencyCode: {{costs.0.currency}}),
        MonarchSavingsAmount({{costs.1.amount}}, currencyCode: {{costs.1.currency}}),
    ],
    unpricedCount: {{unpricedCount}},
    categories: [
        MonarchSavingsCategory(id: {{categories.0.id}}, count: {{categories.0.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsCategory(id: {{categories.1.id}}, count: {{categories.1.count}}),
    ],
    decisions: [
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: {{decisions.0.id}}, label: {{decisions.0.label}}, count: {{decisions.0.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: {{decisions.1.id}}, label: {{decisions.1.label}}, count: {{decisions.1.count}}),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: {{decisions.2.id}}, label: {{decisions.2.label}}, count: {{decisions.2.count}}),
    ],
    potentialSavings: [MonarchSavingsAmount({{potentialSavings.0.amount}}, currencyCode: {{potentialSavings.0.currency}})],
    items: [
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: {{items.0.id}},
            name: {{items.0.name}},
            category: {{items.0.category}},
            date: {{items.0.date|date}},
            amount: MonarchSavingsAmount({{items.0.amount}}, currencyCode: {{items.0.currency}}),
            decision: {{items.0.decision}}
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: {{items.1.id}},
            name: {{items.1.name}},
            category: {{items.1.category}},
            date: {{items.1.date|date}},
            isUnpriced: {{items.1.unpriced}},
            decision: {{items.1.decision}}
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: {{items.2.id}},
            name: {{items.2.name}},
            category: {{items.2.category}},
            date: {{items.2.date|date}},
            amount: MonarchSavingsAmount({{items.2.amount}}, currencyCode: {{items.2.currency}}),
            decision: {{items.2.decision}}
        ),
    ],
    registry: registry,
    description: {{description}},
    locale: Locale(identifier: {{locale}}),
    calendar: calendar
) {
    Button({{actionLabel}}) {}
        .buttonStyle(.monarchLink(.standalone))
        .underline()
}
examples.code:
MonarchSavingsPanel(
    unusedCount: 3,
    costs: [
        MonarchSavingsAmount(45, currencyCode: "GBP"),
        MonarchSavingsAmount(20, currencyCode: "EUR"),
    ],
    unpricedCount: 1,
    categories: [
        MonarchSavingsCategory(id: "parked", count: 2),
        MonarchSavingsCategory(id: "no_dns", count: 1),
    ],
    decisions: [
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: "keep", label: "Keep", count: 1),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: "let_lapse", label: "Let lapse", count: 1),
        MonarchSavingsDecisionCount(id: "undecided", label: "Undecided", count: 1),
    ],
    potentialSavings: [MonarchSavingsAmount(15, currencyCode: "GBP")],
    items: [
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: "a",
            name: "example.com",
            category: "parked",
            date: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_799_539_200),
            amount: MonarchSavingsAmount(15, currencyCode: "GBP"),
            decision: "let_lapse"
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: "b",
            name: "example.net",
            category: "no_dns",
            date: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_803_945_600),
            isUnpriced: true,
            decision: "review"
        ),
        MonarchSavingsItem(
            id: "c",
            name: "example.org",
            category: "parked",
            date: Date(timeIntervalSince1970: 1_808_179_200),
            amount: MonarchSavingsAmount(20, currencyCode: "EUR"),
            decision: "keep"
        ),
    ],
    registry: registry,
    description: "Parked, without a website or without DNS.",
    locale: Locale(identifier: "en-GB"),
    calendar: calendar
) {
    Button("Review all") {}
        .buttonStyle(.monarchLink(.standalone))
        .underline()
}
